subject: MAP: Elara Systems evaluation — security gating & retention questions
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Marino <sofia.marino@elara-systems.com>, procurement@elara-systems.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 07 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Elara Systems evaluation — security gating & retention questions

Hi Sofia / Elara team,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great discussion. As we formalize the mutual action plan (MAP) for the evaluation and procurement path, I want to surface the security/compliance gates that will determine our close timeline and what evidence we need from your side. Goal: make the MAP explicit so procurement and security can align and we avoid last-minute blockers.

High-level asks for the MAP we discussed: 
- SOC 2: your latest Type II report + AICPA attestation and date range.
- SIG / CAIQ: your completed questionnaire (or responsive XLSX) and any known gaps we should inventory.
- DPA: draft redlines for our standard DPA, specifically around data retention and subprocessor disclosures.
- Data residency & retention: confirmation of default retention windows and options for shorter retention for US and EU customers.

Proposed owners / deadlines (suggested):
- Elara: SOC 2 report + SIG answers — due Wed 2025-06-11 (owner: Sofia)
- Redwood legal & sales: DPA redline review — target by Mon 2025-06-16 (owner: Kimberly)
- Joint: final MAP and signoff meeting — Fri 2025-06-20 (owner: Markus)

Can you confirm the SOC 2 coverage period and whether you can upload the evidence to the shared Drive link below? If you have a SIG spreadsheet ready, sending that will help us triage high-risk items (encryption, key management, access reviews) ahead of the legal review.

Shared evidence folder (please upload PDFs/XLSX): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bExampleElaraEvidence

I'll attach an initial MAP workbook (internal version) to capture tasks and owners; happy to switch to your format if preferred.

Thanks — simple next step: confirm dates above and whether procurement wants the DocuSign route or a legal redline first.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx stub)

Date: Sun, 08 Jun 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Elara Systems evaluation — security gating & retention questions

Hi Markus / team,

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick update from security and procurement:

1) SOC 2: attaching our latest report (Elara_SOC2_Report_2024.pdf). Coverage period is 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31, Type II.
2) SIG/CAIQ: we've exported our responses — sending elara-sig-answers.xlsx with column-level notes for a few items we flagged (KMS, vendor access, logging retention).
3) DPA: procurement prefers to receive Redwood's standard DPA and then we'll provide a tracked redline. Two specific retention questions from legal: (a) can Redwood support a 30-day session-only retention option for EU test tenants, and (b) how do you handle exports for customers under legal hold?

We can meet for a MAP sync next week. For evidence, we'll upload both files to the Drive folder you shared by EOD Mon 2025-06-09. Procurement copied here — please advise preferred sequence (DocuSign vs redline).

Thanks,
Sofia Marino
CISO, Elara Systems
sofia.marino@elara-systems.com

Attachments: Elara_SOC2_Report_2024.pdf (pdf stub); elara-sig-answers.xlsx (xlsx stub)

Sofia — thanks for the fast turnaround and for uploading the SOC 2 / SIG stubs. I've reviewed both briefly and pulled the high-level implications for the MAP below. Putting this in the thread so procurement/legal can see tasking and timeline.

MAP action items (updated):
- Elara: Upload full SOC 2 report and any complementary evidence (control narratives) — due 2025-06-09 (completed per Sofia). Owner: Sofia.
- Elara: Complete SIG follow-up responses for these items: KMS key rotation cadence, user access review cadence, logging retention TTLs — due 2025-06-12. Owner: Sofia.
- Redwood Security: Provide option for 30-day session-only retention for EU test tenancy and confirmation on export/hold behavior — due 2025-06-13. Owner: Jordan Blake (Engineering liaison).
- Redwood Legal: Review Elara redlines to DPA and propose counterpoints; highlight data retention clause alternatives (30/90/365 days) — due 2025-06-16. Owner: Kimberly Park.
- Joint: MAP signoff meeting (finalize DPA approach and acceptance gates) — scheduled for 2025-06-20 10:00 AM PT. Owner: Markus Klein.

Notes & risks observed:
- SOC 2 coverage looks fine but we need the control narratives for two encrypt-at-rest items to validate key management (kept as MAP risk).
- SIG answers indicate a default logging retention of 365 days; if Elara requires shorter retention for EU data sets we need an engineering scoping ticket to evaluate impact.
- DPA clause: Elara asked about legal hold / export for customer data; Redwood standard supports exports but legal hold scenarios require a review of storage/backups (we'll document exception handling).

Action: Kimberly, can you start a focused legal review on the DPA and flag non-starters? Jordan, please confirm engineering feasibility for the 30-day retention option and estimate effort (SLO and cost delta). Sofia, once your SIG follow-ups land we'll reprioritize high-risk items for remediation or compensating controls.

I've attached the MAP workbook (Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx) which captures owners, deadlines, and evidence links. I'll send a calendar invite for the 6/20 signoff meeting after we confirm availability.

Best,
Markus

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx stub)
